purchaseOrders._selfApprove_note: No self-approval (Karl, 2026-10-24): every PO needs at least the first approver. Setting selfApproveUnder (e.g. 50) would issue POs under that amount on the call.
purchaseOrders._approvalLevels_note: Cascade, lowest first. A request climbs the levels in turn and stops at the first whose 'upTo' is above the amount; the last level has no limit. 'role' is the jobs.csv column (header with a lower-case first letter) holding who approves at that level on each job.
purchaseOrders._defaultApprovers_note: Used when a job's role cell is blank. Staff names or emails, ';' between several.
purchaseOrders._testRequesterEmail_note: POC only: sends every requester's outcome email here instead of their staff-list address. Remove for live.
